answer: Step 1 says the fixture runs `desk install`; Resolved Decisions says `deskops init`. DeskCLI.install scaffolds desk/ only and never creates the .sldb store or lifecycle graph (deskops/cli/commands/desk.py:57-83). Fix: make step 1 run `deskops init <root>` (parser.py:455-462).

Exit codes are unpinned. Observed: runtime status returns 0 with no space (runtime.py:42-43); attach/stop return 1 (runtime.py:46-48); add faq-doc, atoms list/show and init return 0. Fix: state each subcommand's expected code in the task.

No stable line is named. Verified: runtime status/attach/stop print 'No Herdr Space found for <identity>' (runtime.py:42-47); add faq-doc prints 'Created ...' (operations.py:40); atoms list prints nothing unless an atom is seeded (atoms.py:161-168). Fix: name one line per command.

These handlers print their stable line to stdout via print() (runtime.py:33,43,48; atoms.py:160-168; operations.py:40); capsys captures both streams, so assert capsys.readouterr().out. main() sends unexpected exceptions to stderr (main.py:384-390).

No top-level --root: build_parser adds only subparsers (parser.py:24-58); each command defines its own --root (parser.py:110-155 atoms list/show; parser.py:68,73,76,89 runtime). --root must follow the subcommand; a leading --root is unrecognized.

With no live Herdr Space: status prints 'No Herdr Space found for <identity>' and returns 0 (runtime.py:41-43); attach and stop print the same line and return 1 (runtime.py:46-48). init returns 0 only with the server/desk stubs (runtime.py:24-33); supervise runs run_supervise_loop (runtime.py:63-112).

supervise blocks in run_supervise_loop (runtime.py:63-111); --max-iterations defaults None = run forever and --timeout-ms defaults None (parser.py:90-105). Pass --max-iterations 1 with a Herdr stub to terminate; it returns 1 when the last status is timeout/unknown (runtime.py:109-111).

test_herdr_runtime.py stubs via HerdrClient(runner=...) (test_herdr_runtime.py:47,80), unreachable from main. Main-level pattern: monkeypatch.setattr('deskops.cli.commands.runtime.HerdrClient', Fake) (test_cli.py:2399); also stub ensure_herdr_server/initialize_desk for init (runtime.py:3,24).
A parametrized function still yields a distinct pytest nodeid per case, so each subcommand gets its own test; grouping is a style choice Scope already permits.

desk/drawer/tasks/task-<slug>.md with frontmatter id, status: deferred, references: [], depends_on, pills, files, task_type, tags (task-rw-f0-reject-ambiguous-selectors.md:1-22), then the standard sections.

Exit code and line are undefined, so 'surprise' is undecidable. Fix: pin expected exit 0 plus one named line per subcommand, then xfail(strict=True) only where the observed run contradicts that contract (crash, wrong code, missing line).
Xfail is applied only after observing a contract failure; a passing subcommand is left passing, so strict xfail never sees an unexpected pass. No decision needed.

All 9 depends_on tasks are still status: deferred in desk/drawer/tasks (task-rw-f0-reject-ambiguous-selectors.md:3); desk/tasks/ holds only Board.md and task-write-end-to-end-deskops-operator-manual.md, so none are promoted or closed.
